facts.text: I got an error message saying the number of levels of each grouping factor must be less than the number of observations (problems: participant).
I said this is a mixed factorial design.
I said participants might be changed.
I asked to fix errors for a mixed factor ANOVA analysis.
I provided R code that generates sample data with set.seed(123).
I created a data frame named data with participant as a factor from 1 to 30.
I set group to 15 control participants and 15 experimental participants.
I set time to morning, afternoon, and evening repeated 5 times for each group half.
I generated performance values using rnorm with mean 50 and sd 10 for the control group.
I generated performance values using rnorm with mean 55 and sd 10 for the experimental group.
I used the lme4 package in R.
I fit a mixed-effects model with lmer(performance ~ group + time + (1|participant), data = data).
I asked to fix the R codes again.

keyphrases: number of levels of each grouping factor
